verdict.rationale: Performance and item caps are a fair question for an issue tracker, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of item limits, scale thresholds, or performance in workspaces with tens of thousands of issues. Community comments describing Jira as fast or slow are anecdotal, never tied to workspace size, and do not document the capability, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an engineer, I know how the product performs and whether item caps apply in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks
